additional_aspect_ownership.remaining_scope: Existing event-thread, desktop, display and lifecycle contracts remain with these owners.
Existing Swing utility owners; callback thread, model and platform behavior need actual contract tests for any future additions.
Existing image I/O and service registry; preserve codec/provider selection and image/stream ownership.
Existing beans utilities and event support; metadata caching and listener contracts remain distinct.
Formats, flavor maps and clipboard lifecycle remain on existing owners.
Existing system factories and service providers; platform/device support is not implied by source presence.
Existing parser/schema/catalogue factories; namespace, entity-resolution, provider and resource contracts remain explicit.
Existing expression, transformation and signature factories; preserve distinct evaluation and provider protocols.
Existing management factories and JMX proxy/connection owners; source evidence does not qualify remote behavior.
NamingManager and Preferences are existing discovery/factory owners; contexts retain their stateful lifecycle.
Keep existing logging hierarchy, handler dispatch, levels and manager ownership.
Existing registry/export factories and XA protocol; no catch-all remote utility is introduced.
Existing engine, shell and linker factories; language/provider and execution lifecycle remain distinct.
Use existing compiler tools, attributed model utilities and doclet extension protocol.

additional_aspect_ownership.aspect: Jar jlink jpackage and command tools
additional_aspect_ownership.remaining_scope: ToolProvider is the public service route for declared jar/jdeps/jlink/jmod/jpackage tool providers; implementation packages are not promoted to public APIs.
Existing recording, agent and debugger protocols; runtime feature/platform availability still requires actual image qualification.
Reuse JCA/JCE/TLS/authentication factories and service ownership. Provider implementation modules including Windows MSCAPI do not need new public facades.
Existing locale/text/random owners and provider routes; preserve Unicode, locale and generator contracts.
Existing source owners only; preview and incubating status are recorded explicitly and never treated as stable API qualification.
